boundaries: private authenticated virtual display; no host display sockets in guest
existing fixed framebuffer and allowlisted keyboard protocol
disposable files only; no evidence write access
no network or physical device access
bounded output and screenshots; verified cleanup
verification_steps: mark visible menu and capture screenshot
start NEW single-player game; do not load historical saves
mark level transition; confirm MAP01 identity and capture screenshot
confirm movement, turning, firing and use separately
test physical Pause/Break for DOOM II; do not instruct P as the pause key
confirm historical-save and multiplayer utility non-use separately
observation_policy: Missing markers stay unknown. Record raw UI results and later human clarifications separately. A post-game screenshot is not gameplay evidence.
stop_policy: One separately authorized execution only; stop on failed preflight; no automatic retry. A deadline is not by itself a game crash.
